description: ProDataGrid is a high-performance DataGrid control for Avalonia.

latest_release.name: ProDataGrid v12.1.5
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Charting: coalesced worker-to-UI updates without per-observation snapshot rebuilds by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/379
* Improve statistical stability and add descriptive-statistic functions by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/378
* Add bounded bitwise formulas with array evaluation and integer-oracle tests by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/381
* Add bounded radix conversions and exact integer-to-binary64 parsing by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/383
* Charting: atomic multi-series streaming with aligned reduction and shared identities by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/382
* Add scaled covariance, correlation and single-fit array forecasting by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/384
* Add percentile ranks and bounded shared-distribution ranking queries by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/386
* Add bounded FREQUENCY distributions with indexed bins and owned results by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/388
* Charting: atomic coordinate and trailing-span windows over synchronized streams by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/387
* Add exact-accumulated trimmed means and shared multi-percentage evaluation by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/389
* Add MODE.MULT and bounded streaming mode aggregation by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/393
* Add streaming AVERAGEA MINA MAXA with exact private mean accumulation by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/394
* Charting: live fixed and trailing coordinate windows for chart models by @wieslawsoltes in https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/pull/392


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/ProDataGrid/compare/v12.1.0.6...v12.1.5

hot_issues.title: Focused row is never un-hidden after recycling (v2 logical scrolling): row disappears and leaves a blank slot
Stale / partially cleared rows remain after ItemsSource is replaced with an empty list
Proposal: let selected cells follow their row item, so inserts and removals above a cell selection do not rewrite every selected cell
Every insert/remove rebuilds a reference-to-index dictionary of all rows (`EnsureReferenceIndexLookup`)
Plain-text copy wraps every cell in double quotes, so pasted values keep their quotes
Inserting or removing rows rebuilds the whole row selection, at a cost that grows with the number of selected rows
Every items-source change builds a selection record for every row and matches selected items with nested loops
Visible row details are left out of the row height estimate: scrolling jumps to the bottom and inserts above drift the offset
